summary.business_type: B2B manufacturer product catalog (tyre valves, export trade, RFQ-based, no cart)
top_findings: Soft 404: every unknown URL returns HTTP 200 with homepage content; no 404.html in dist
696KB logo PNG (1024x1024) displayed at 40x40 and loaded eagerly on all 163 pages
No BreadcrumbList JSON-LD despite visible breadcrumbs on all 163 pages
Product schema missing offers/sku/mpn - ineligible for Google rich results
Mobile product-page info grid overflows horizontally by 170px on all SKU pages
Near-duplicate sibling product descriptions (29 groups covering ~60-70 of 148 product pages)
quick_wins: Resize logo to ~160px WebP (~5KB) - saves ~690KB on every first visit
Emit BreadcrumbList from BreadcrumbNav.vue - one component covers all 163 pages
Add FAQPage JSON-LD to pages already rendering visible FAQs (home, 6 categories, news)
Add fetchpriority=high + preload to first hero banner image
Link model-number cells in spec tables to sibling product pages (+508 exact-match internal links)
Make product-page info-box grid responsive (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Zero mixed content, clean URL structure, llms.txt present

findings.title: Soft 404s site-wide
findings.description: Unknown URLs return HTTP 200 with homepage content; no 404.html emitted in dist; wastes crawl budget and dilutes signals
findings.recommendation: Emit static 404.html and configure host to return real 404 status; add 301 from non-trailing-slash to trailing-slash URLs

findings.title: Non-trailing-slash URLs return 200 duplicate
findings.description: /about, /search etc. serve duplicate homepage content instead of 301 to /about/
findings.recommendation: Configure host redirect rules non-slash -> slash

findings.title: All 163 sitemap lastmod identical
findings.description: Every URL stamped with build date; lastmod loses meaning for recrawl prioritization
findings.recommendation: Stamp lastmod from actual content change date in gen-sitemap.mjs

findings.title: No security/cache headers
findings.description: vite preview sends no HSTS/CSP/Cache-Control (host-level config)
findings.recommendation: Configure production host headers: long-cache immutable /assets, security headers

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: No thin product pages (404-582 words each)
No duplicate or missing titles; natural spec-driven copy
Clean heading hierarchy on inner pages; 4 strong ~2,200-word news articles

findings.title: Near-duplicate sibling product descriptions
findings.description: 29 groups covering ~60-70 of 148 product pages; e.g. VC-8 cap family identical except color word - risks SERP clustering/filtering of model pages
findings.recommendation: Add 1-2 differentiating sentences per sibling (vehicle applications, compatibility, packaging)

findings.title: Homepage renders 3 H1s (hero carousel)
findings.description: Each hero slide outputs an H1
findings.recommendation: Keep first slide H1, demote slides 2-3 to div/p

findings.title: 161/163 titles exceed 60 chars
findings.description: Model-first titles are good but truncate in SERP
findings.recommendation: Trim suffix patterns to keep core model + category within 60 chars where possible

findings.title: News articles lack author + internal links to products
findings.description: No E-E-A-T author signal, articles don't link to catalog pages
findings.recommendation: Add author/date byline and in-article links to relevant product/category pages

findings.title: About page has no certifications
findings.description: No ISO/IATF/QA content anywhere on site
findings.recommendation: Add certifications + factory capability content to About

categories.name: On-Page & Search Experience
what_works: Intent mapping clean across page types; model-first titles match buyer queries
Request Quote CTA + breadcrumbs on product pages; 100% spec-table coverage
Homepage answers who/what/contact within first screen (visual score 82)

findings.title: Mobile product-page info grid overflows 170px
findings.description: MOQ/Packaging/Lead Time grid doesn't collapse on 390px viewport - affects every SKU page
findings.recommendation: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 on the info-box grid

findings.title: 508 unlinked sibling-model references in spec tables
findings.description: Spec tables list series models as plain text while each has its own page
findings.recommendation: Link model cells to their product pages - exact-match internal links

findings.title: Subcategory pages lack consolidated comparison tables
findings.description: Category pages list products but no series-wide size comparison table - biggest featured-snippet opportunity; data already exists
findings.recommendation: Add consolidated model/size comparison table to each of 6 subcategory pages

findings.title: WhatsApp float covers content on mobile
findings.description: FAB overlaps text/links on all pages at 390px
findings.recommendation: Reduce size / add safe-area offset on mobile

findings.title: 11 pages missing og:image
findings.description: Some category/utility pages lack og:image
findings.recommendation: Set default og:image fallback

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Organization schema on homepage and Product schema on 148 product pages are valid JSON with absolute URLs
No parse errors, no placeholder values

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList anywhere
findings.description: Visual breadcrumbs render on all 163 pages but emit no schema
findings.recommendation: Emit BreadcrumbList JSON-LD from BreadcrumbNav.vue - one component change, SERP-visible result

findings.title: Product schema ineligible for rich results
findings.description: Missing offers/review/aggregateRating and sku/mpn
findings.recommendation: Add mpn (model number), brand, and Offer (businessFunction/priceSpecification appropriate for B2B RFQ) to Product JSON-LD

findings.title: 14/163 pages have zero JSON-LD
findings.description: All category, news, about, contact pages have no structured data
findings.recommendation: Add CollectionPage to subcategories, Article/NewsArticle to news (headline, image, datePublished, author), ContactPage/AboutPage

findings.title: FAQ sections without FAQPage markup
findings.description: Visible FAQs on home + 6 categories + 4 news pages; Google FAQ rich results deprecated for most sites but still valuable for AI surfaces
findings.recommendation: Emit FAQPage JSON-LD from FaqSection.vue

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Route-level code splitting, 98.7% WebP images, zero webfonts, zero third-party scripts
Broad lazy loading, prerendered SSG HTML

findings.title: 696KB logo PNG displayed at 40x40
findings.description: 1024x1024 PNG loaded eagerly in header on all 163 pages - largest single byte cost on the site
findings.recommendation: Resize to ~160px WebP (~5KB)

findings.title: Hero carousel images eager, no fetchpriority
findings.description: All 3 hero banners (1920x640 webp) load eagerly; LCP image competes with ~930KB eager imagery
findings.recommendation: fetchpriority=high on first slide only, lazy-load slides 2-3, add preload

findings.title: 298KB products.js inside main bundle
findings.description: Full catalog hoisted into 356KB app bundle via SiteHeader/SearchBar imports - downloaded on every page
findings.recommendation: Split search index into a lazily loaded chunk (dynamic import on search focus)

findings.title: No srcset / width+height on content images
findings.description: Responsive sizing and CLS reserves missing
findings.recommendation: Add width/height attrs; generate srcset variants for product images

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: Fully pre-rendered HTML - trivially crawlable by AI bots
Spec-compliant llms.txt, real HTML spec tables, consistent NAP

findings.title: Zero certification (ISO/IATF) content
findings.description: AI answers about 'reliable tyre valve manufacturer' lean on certifications; site has none
findings.recommendation: Publish certifications + QA process content (About + homepage block)

findings.title: Missing buyer-question content (MOQ/lead time/payment/shipping)
findings.description: Top B2B buyer questions not answered anywhere - AI engines can't cite the site for them
findings.recommendation: Add per-page or FAQ answers for MOQ, lead time, OEM, payment, shipping

findings.title: robots.txt has no explicit AI-crawler policy
findings.description: GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot not mentioned (default allow)
findings.recommendation: Explicitly allow major AI crawlers in robots.txt

categories.name: Images
what_works: 100% alt coverage across 2,802 images with keyword-rich product/news alts

findings.title: Oversized logo PNG sitewide
findings.description: 696KB PNG at 40px display
findings.recommendation: Replace with small WebP/SVG

findings.title: Zero srcset anywhere
findings.description: Full-size images served to mobile
findings.recommendation: Generate responsive variants for hero + product images

findings.title: No width/height attributes (CLS risk)
findings.description: Images lack dimension reserves
findings.recommendation: Add width/height or aspect-ratio boxes in ProductCard and product gallery

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Emit 404.html + configure real 404 status and slash redirects on host
Homepage hero: single H1, fetchpriority on first slide

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: FAQPage JSON-LD from existing FAQ content
CollectionPage + Article schema for category/news pages
Link spec-table model cells to sibling pages (+508 internal links)
Split search index out of main JS bundle
Differentiating copy for 29 near-duplicate sibling groups

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Consolidated comparison tables on 6 subcategory pages
News articles: author bylines + links to products

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Capture drift baseline; re-audit after deployment to real host (headers, compression, real CWV)
